import numpy as np
from rcb_behavior import _T_of


def arm_world(s, p, arm, pos, quat, max_dq=0.01, settle=20, tol=0.04):
    kin = s._kin()
    names = list(s.robot.joints)
    positions = s.robot.get_joint_positions()
    seed = np.array([float(positions[names.index(n)]) for n in kin.q_names])
    base = s.robot_state()["base_pose"]
    world_from_base = _T_of(base[:3], base[3:])
    link = f"{arm}_eef_link"
    target = np.linalg.inv(world_from_base) @ _T_of(pos, quat)
    start = 11 if arm == "right" else 4
    q, err, ok = kin.solve(
        {link: (link, np.eye(4), target)},
        seed, list(range(start, start + 7)),
        s._kin_lo, s._kin_hi, tol, 0.1, 100,
    )
    print("IK", arm, bool(ok), err, np.round(q[start:start + 7], 3), flush=True)
    if ok:
        p["move_joints"]({arm: q[start:start + 7]}, max_dq=max_dq, settle=settle)
    print("EEF", p["get_eef_pose"](arm), flush=True)
    return ok


def full_world(s, p, arm, pos, quat, max_dq=0.01, settle=20):
    kin = s._kin()
    q0 = [float(s.robot.joints[n].get_state()[0][0]) for n in kin.q_names]
    result = s.kinematics({"op": "ik", "targets": {f"{arm}_eef_link": list(pos) + list(quat)},
                           "seed": q0, "base_pose": s.robot_state()["base_pose"]})
    print("IK FULL", result["ok"], result.get("error"), flush=True)
    if result["ok"]:
        q = result["q"]
        start = 11 if arm == "right" else 4
        p["move_joints"]({"trunk": q[:4], arm: q[start:start + 7]},
                         max_dq=max_dq, settle=settle)
    print("EEF", p["get_eef_pose"](arm), flush=True)
    return result["ok"]
